content: एकादश {%a.%} (-शी|{%f.%}) .²1 Eleventh. आत्मैकादशः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 9. 4</ls>. .²2 Consisting of eleven. .²3 Lasting for eleven months. .{@-शी@} .²1 The eleventh day of every fortnight of a lunar month, sacred to Viṣṇu; (when fasting is enjoined and is considered to be productive of great religious merit). .²2 Presentations of offerings to decease ancestors or Pitṛs on the eleventh day after decease. .{@-शम्@} The number eleven.
